minecraft:lore: Made from gold and a torch

meta.notes: pattern is the crafting grid, one string per row; a space is an empty slot. key maps each letter to an item id (or #tag). result is the item stack crafted: id, count and optional components, here a name, a lore line and a rarity colour. category only sorts the recipe in the recipe book. The recipe works in any crafting table after /reload.
